caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #115: AMELIORATE

ameliorate (verb): to make a bad situation better.

✅ In a sentence: New drainage canals helped ameliorate flooding in the low-lying neighborhoods.
✅ Similar: improve, ease, alleviate
✅ Remember it: Latin melior = better. Opposite: exacerbate.
